description: Search GitHunt's pre-indexed pool of GitHub developers by location, role, and skills. Returns candidates ranked by fit with scores, activity, and contact info. Fast (pool-served, no live crawl); page with offset.

domains.description: Domain vocabulary packs to score candidates' repos/bio against for subject-matter evidence, e.g. ['payments']. Max 3. One of: payments, healthcare, adtech.

excludeList.description: Name of a seen list (see add_seen_logins) whose logins are excluded from this search, so a rerun of the same brief never returns candidates already recorded. Server-side, bounded at 5000 logins. An unknown list name is an error, not an empty exclusion.

excludeLocations.description: Countries or cities to exclude, e.g. ['India'].

excludeLogins.description: GitHub logins to leave out, e.g. candidates already seen; use for dedup across searches.

excludeUtcOffsets.description: Exclude candidates whose location lies entirely within this UTC offset band in hours, e.g. {min: 0, max: 5}; unknown locations are kept.

includeUnlocated.description: If true, also search candidates with no stated location; results with no stated location are returned as screening leads.

isHireable.description: Only candidates whose GitHub profile sets the 'hireable' flag.

location.description: City or country to search, freeform, e.g. 'Warsaw', 'San Francisco', 'Poland'. Common abbreviations and native names are normalized (SF, NYC, UK, Warszawa). Optional when 'locations' or 'regions' is given; at least one of the three is required.

locations.description: Additional cities/countries to search alongside 'location', e.g. ['Berlin', 'Warsaw']. Max 10 combined with 'location'. Only the first location gets a live GitHub crawl if the pool is empty; the rest are served from the candidate pool only.

maxResults.description: Candidates to return per call (1-100, default 25).

minExperienceYears.description: Minimum years since the GitHub account was created.

offset.description: Top-ranked candidates to skip, for paging (0-200, default 0). Use with maxResults to fetch the next page. Each search scores at most ~200 candidates, so pages past that are empty.

organizations.description: GitHub org logins to check candidates' employer affinity against, e.g. ['stripe', 'adyen']. Max 20.

regions.description: Named region shortcuts that expand to their member countries, merged with 'location'/'locations'. Max 3. One of: north-america, latin-america, south-america, europe, western-europe, eastern-europe, nordics, dach, benelux, iberia, uk-ireland, middle-east, africa, apac, east-asia, southeast-asia, south-asia, oceania, americas, emea, worldwide. Case-insensitive; unrecognized names are dropped rather than rejected.

requireOrgAffinity.description: If true, only return candidates matching one of the given 'organizations'/'sectors' (hard filter). Default false, which boosts matching candidates instead of excluding the rest.

role.description: Role to rank candidates for. One of: fullstack, frontend, backend, mobile, devops, ai-engineer, ai-orchestrator, ml-engineer, data-scientist, data-engineer, security, cloud, blockchain, embedded, gamedev, ios-developer, android-developer, sre, platform-engineer, qa-engineer, solutions-architect, cto, vp-engineering, head-engineering, engineering-manager, tech-lead, product-manager, director-engineering, payments.

sectors.description: Industry sectors to check candidates' employer affinity against, via GitHunt's employer graph. Max 5. One of: adtech, ai-ml, banking, cloud, cybersecurity, ecommerce, fintech, gaming, healthtech, media, mobility, payments.

skillRecency.description: Filter on public skill activity, e.g. [{skill: 'Scala', usedWithinYears: 3}]. Max 10 entries, ANDed; each entry needs at least one of minActiveYears/usedWithinYears. Candidates whose signals cannot answer the question are counted as unknown in meta.skill_recency and left out of results - that is missing evidence, not a negative finding. Setting this serves the search from the candidate pool alone.

minActiveYears.description: Minimum distinct calendar years with public activity in this skill (a year counts at 5+ commits). A public-activity measure, never elapsed or commercial tenure.

skill.description: Language or skill name; aliases resolve (ts, js, py, rb, kt, rs, sh, cpp, c#, golang).

usedWithinYears.description: Require dated activity inside a rolling window of this many years ending at the request's UTC timestamp.

skills.description: Technologies or keywords to match, e.g. ['react', 'typescript']. Synonyms are handled (k8s -> kubernetes).

strictSkills.description: If true, exclude candidates that match none of the given skills.

name: search_developers

locationSuggestions.description: Similar supported locations, present when the location matched nothing.

excludeList.description: The seen list merged into the exclusion, present when excludeList was given.

skillRecency.description: Eligibility counts over every candidate seen, present when skillRecency was given. `unknown` is missing evidence (those candidates are queued for enrichment); `partial` means retrieval was bounded, so an empty page is not evidence of absence.

domainEvidence.description: Present when 'domains' were given; keyed by pack name.

evidence.description: Where each matched skill/keyword was found.

inferredUtcOffset.description: UTC offset inferred from the candidate's own commit timestamps, when known.

locationResolution.description: How the stated base resolved at the run timestamp, present when the request carried an exclusion or skillRecency. Ambiguous and unresolved candidates are still returned and belong in a screening queue, not in a geographically eligible shortlist; commit timezone never establishes a country. screeningReason 'inferred_offset_in_excluded_band' means the stated location did not resolve and the commit timezone falls inside excludeUtcOffsets - not excluded, ask them where they are based.

scoreBoosts.description: Ranking boosts applied on top of the 0-100 score; results are ordered by the boosted value.
